item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-R03-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-R03-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"China's CCPR entry shows the date 5 October 1998 and no child records to display.","notes":["The excerpt does not explicitly label the date as a signature date or establish non-ratification."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-R03-E003","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The database lists China's ninth CEDAW periodic report, a reply to the list of issues submitted on 2 March 2023, and civil-society information dated 13 April 2023.","notes":["The excerpt does not support additional written information after an April-May dialogue or concluding observations issued on 25 May and published on 1 June 2023."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-R03-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"China's third periodic report under ICESCR was submitted on 19 December 2019, published on 5 August 2020, and is listed under session 73 (2023).","notes":["The excerpt does not support concluding observations issued on 3 March 2023 or published on 13 March 2023."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-R03-E005","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The database shows no child records to display for China's CAT Article 22 individual complaints procedure entry.","notes":["The excerpt does not establish that China has not accepted the procedure."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-R03-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
